sections.title: What this resource is
sections.text: A computational reference entry for the Monster, with invariants, generator conventions and links to algorithms and subgroup data.

sections.title: Facts to look up
sections.text: Its order is 808017424794512875886459904961710757005754368000000000. Standard generators are chosen with a in class 2A, b in class 3B, and ab of order 29.

sections.title: How the reference supports computation
sections.text: Black-box recipes seek elements in suitable classes, conjugate them and test product orders. Additional checks distinguish acceptable standard generators; the opening order conditions are not a freestanding construction of the Monster.

sections.title: Reading the evidence correctly
sections.text: This is a data-and-algorithm resource rather than a paper reporting an experiment. Several representation notes are dated 1997–2000. Treat their machine timings and availability statements historically.

sections.title: Best use here
sections.text: Use the entry to verify exact group size and notation before reading moonshine surveys. Do not infer a complete modern subgroup classification from this page alone.
